# Mushood

> Khawaja Muhammad Mushood is a full-stack software engineer in Lahore, Pakistan, building web and mobile products with React, React Native, Node.js/Nest.js and PostgreSQL. This file indexes his portfolio site, his published writing, and his public credentials.

The portfolio is a single page. About, Resume, Portfolio, Blog and Contact are
switched client-side rather than routed, so they all share the one canonical URL
and there are no per-section links to follow. The facts that have no URL of their
own are recorded here instead.

Currently Software Engineer at [Texagon](https://texagon.io/) (Aug 2025 –
present): full-stack React and Node.js/Nest.js work, high-speed REST APIs with
Redis caching, and Supabase integration. Previously Web Developer at
[Code To Kloud](https://codetokloud.com/) (Apr 2025 – Aug 2025), building a
HIPAA-aligned platform with JWT authentication and a React Native app with token
refresh and centralised error handling; before that Software Engineer Intern at
[Arbisoft](https://arbisoft.com/) (Jul 2024 – Sep 2024), working on real-time
Firebase data and mobile push notifications shipped through CircleCI.

BSc in Computer Science, University of Management and Technology, 2021–2025,
CGPA 3.7/4.0.

Skills, as grouped on the site:

- Languages: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, C++, Bash, HTML5, CSS, JSON, YAML
- Frontend: React, Next.js, Vite, Angular; React Native and Expo on mobile; Redux, Redux Toolkit, Redux Saga, Zustand and Context API for state; React Router, React Navigation, App Router, TanStack Router; Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, TanStack Query, RTK Query, Axios
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Fastify, FastAPI; REST, GraphQL, WebSockets, webhooks; JWT, AWS Cognito, Clerk, BetterAuth; Redis, Valkey, BullMQ
- Databases and ORMs: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Amazon Aurora, DynamoDB, Firebase Realtime DB, Supabase Realtime; Prisma, TypeORM, Mongoose, Drizzle; Zod, Joi, Yup, Express Validator
- Testing: unit tests, E2E, Jest, Vitest
- Cloud and deployment: Firebase, Supabase, AWS, Google Cloud, Azure; Firestore, Firebase Auth, edge functions, Supabase Storage, RDS, EC2, S3; Vercel, Railway, Netlify
- DevOps and tooling: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, GitHub Actions, CircleCI; Docker, Nginx, PM2; Postman, Swagger UI
- Environment and practices: Android Studio, Xcode, VS Code, Cursor; coding agents; HIPAA, GDPR and EU AI Act compliance

Services offered: frontend development, backend development, cross-platform
mobile apps, and AI/automation work.

The Portfolio section shows nine projects — Finance, Orizon, Fundo, Brawlhalla,
DSM., MetaSpark, Summary, Task Manager and Arrival — across web development, web
design and applications. They are showcase pieces without individual pages. The
writing linked below is published on Medium and mirrored into the site's Blog
section; recurring subjects are CI/CD and deployment, backend architecture and
caching, React and frontend patterns, developer tooling, and cloud and
networking.

Contact: khawaja.muhammad.mushood@gmail.com, Lahore, Pakistan.

## Site

- [Portfolio](https://mushood123.github.io/): The single-page site itself. Full-stack software engineer crafting scalable web and mobile solutions with React, Node.js & AI automation. Includes a light/dark theme switcher and an AI assistant widget that answers questions about his work by calling a separate backend service.
- [Resume (PDF)](https://mushood123.github.io/assets/resume/KhawajaMuhammadMushoodResume.pdf): Downloadable CV, also linked from the Resume section.
